content.short: Panzerdogs is a Solana-based P2E tank brawler RPG where players own and battle modular NFT commanders and tanks.
content.description: Panzerdogs is a high-action, play-to-earn (P2E) tank brawler RPG built natively on Solana by Lucky Kat Studios. The game features a vibrant virtual world where players own and manage modular NFT assets, including Dog Commanders and craftable tanks. Participants engage in competitive PvP battles, team combat, and PvE missions to earn in-game rewards and exclusive digital collectibles. Utilizing a two-token system ($PANZR and $SCRAP), Panzerdogs provides a responsive gaming experience that bridges the gap between traditional mobile RPGs and the innovative decentralized economy.
content.meta: Panzerdogs offers competitive P2E tank brawling and NFT ownership on Solana. Discover Panzerdogs and other Web3 Games on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
